issues.formula: =COUNTIF(QUERY(FILTER({BASE_DASH!F2:F,BASE_DASH!S2:S},BASE_DASH!C2:C="SITE",BASE_DASH!I2:I="ATIVO"),"select Col1,sum(Col2) group by Col1 label sum(Col2) ''",0),">0")
